questions.question: The award was presented to Elena and ______ after the final performance. Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
questions.explanation: A is correct. The object of the preposition 'to' requires the objective pronoun 'me.'

questions.question: Neither the architect nor the engineers changed ______ recommendation after the inspection. Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
questions.explanation: B is correct. The pronoun agrees with the nearer plural antecedent 'engineers.'

questions.question: When the two satellites entered orbit, ______ began transmitting data within minutes. Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
questions.explanation: C is correct. The plural antecedent 'satellites' requires the plural pronoun 'they.'

questions.question: The scientist ______ the committee invited presented the results on Friday. Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
questions.explanation: D is correct. The pronoun functions as the object of 'invited,' so 'whom' is correct.

questions.question: The blue notebook belongs to Priya, so the notebook on the desk is ______. Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
questions.explanation: A is correct. The independent possessive pronoun 'hers' can stand without a following noun.

questions.question: Every participant must place ______ completed form in the blue folder. Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
questions.explanation: B is correct. The singular subject 'Every participant' requires a singular possessive pronoun in formal agreement.

questions.question: The guide gave Marcus and ______ a map before the hike. Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
questions.explanation: C is correct. The verb 'gave' requires the objective pronoun 'me' in the compound indirect object.

questions.question: Neither the coach nor the players forgot ______ identification cards. Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
questions.explanation: D is correct. The pronoun agrees with the nearer plural antecedent 'players.'

questions.question: After the two manuscripts arrived, ______ were stored in separate cases. Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
questions.explanation: A is correct. The plural antecedent 'manuscripts' requires the plural pronoun 'they.'

questions.question: The engineer ______ the panel selected will lead the inspection. Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
questions.explanation: B is correct. The pronoun is the object of 'selected,' so the objective form 'whom' is correct.

questions.question: That red umbrella belongs to Mateo, so the one near the door is ______. Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
questions.explanation: C is correct. The independent possessive pronoun 'his' can stand without a following noun.
